stance_rationale: The package fails the risk prompt's numerical stability and tail-risk gates: selected post-denoise Σ has cond=411.88 versus the required <=100, CVaR/ES95 materially breaches the default cap, and stress losses exceed RF-R4. The strongest claimed protections rely on non-PIT or missing schedule/crowding artifacts, so this cannot be approved as a risk package.

regime_sigma_audit.comment: Only BULL/BEAR/NORMAL correlations were produced; no CRISIS/CAUTION Σ, bootstrap CI, or fallback exists. run_regime_corr.R also reads rawdata through 2026-05-04 despite package as_of_date 2026-04-30.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: FAIL: TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, and family saturation diagnostics are absent.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Requested WT-local weights.csv and alpha_scores.parquet are absent; vol_scale_path applies current 20260501 active weights backward over 2010-2026 instead of a PIT monthly schedule.
Historical ES path uses current active constituents and fills missing pre-listing returns with zero; A403870 alone has 3095 missing days in 2010-2026 before listing.
Regime labels use right-aligned BM_Ret including the current day and are not t-1 lagged; regime artifact also includes data after as_of_date.
No external macro/FRED series are evidenced in this risk package.
No KR FF5 or factor-return covariance artifact is used; the issue is instead missing BΩB'+D factor coverage evidence.

critical_concerns.description: Selected RMT Σ is PD but numerically fails the required post-shrink condition gate: cond=411.88, above <=100 and even above the reported full-sample condition 377.29; the script only flags RF-R2 at >500.
Method shopping is not apples-to-apples: Ledoit-Wolf constcor reports cond=63.93 on n=66 while selected RMT uses n=206; selection_objective='shrinkage_quality' has no measurable ex-ante objective.
Monthly ES95/CVaR proxy is 17.2162% versus the 2.5% default cap, cvar_breach_flag=true, and no infeasibility_report is provided; labeling it informational does not resolve the breach.

Stress testing fails RF-R4: GFC_2008 cum_ret=-38.64% and MDD=-41.69%, while COVID_2020 MDD=-25.12%; the stress-8 suite is also incomplete because Terror_9_11 has n_obs=0 and Taper/Brexit/Liq Crisis 2022 are absent.

Regime diagnostics are not PIT-safe: run_regime_corr.R uses same-day BM_Ret in the regime label and reads rawdata through 2026-05-04 for a 2026-04-30 as_of package, with no CRISIS fallback or bootstrap CI.

The requested WT-local weights.csv and alpha_scores.parquet are missing, while the risk path uses one current 20260501 active-weight snapshot historically with zero-filled pre-listing returns; this repeats the static-snapshot time-series failure pattern.
Crowding is unverified: TDC vs PG2 active, HHI, style correlation, and family saturation checks are absent, so RF-R3/RF-R5 and L-219 redundancy risk cannot be cleared.
SubStab decay, CDaR95, Gerber/DCC alternatives, and factor coverage R2 are missing; RMT signal_trace_pct=42.96% is not equivalent to the required factor coverage R2.
AX-001 v2 is asserted but not satisfied for a defense-like risk overlay: the package reports only average crisis cumulative return and omits Core MDD relief plus bad/normal IC ratio.

supporting_arguments: PSD itself passes: min_eig=0.0001425288 and no negative eigenvalues, so RF-R9 is not triggered.
RF-R1 is not triggered on the reported common-risk share: market eigenvalue pct is 21.37% and top3 eigmodes are 28.92%.
RF-R6 is not triggered: Hill alpha is 5.7592, above the heavy-tail danger threshold.
Loaded production weights have 18 active names, sum to 1.0, and max weight is 0.20.
unresolved_disputes: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_004 and stage_artifacts/WT_S20260504_004 do not exist; actual artifacts are under stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_004.

WT-S20260504_004 has no local weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, exposure_matrix.parquet, factor_covariance.parquet, specific_risk.parquet, or role-specific risk_challenge_note.md.

Whether a current-constituent historical ES target is admissible for a sizing-only WT is unresolved, but it cannot be treated as a walk-forward schedule without explicit waiver and bias quantification.
The package must specify whether the CVaR cap applies to parametric ES95, CF ES95, EVT ES, or all of them.
weakest_assumption: That RMT denoising improves optimizer-usable risk estimates even though the selected covariance violates cond<=100, has worse condition number than sample, and rejects a lower-condition Ledoit-Wolf candidate using a non-comparable sub-universe.
rebuttal_required: Produce a full-universe estimator comparison with identical N=206 inputs and an ex-ante selection objective; either meet cond<=100 post-shrink or file an infeasibility_report.
Regenerate regime diagnostics with as_of_date cutoff, t-1 lagged labels, CRISIS/CAUTION definitions, bootstrap CI, and a stated fallback.
Provide WT-local weights.csv and alpha_scores.parquet or a formal sizing-only waiver that explicitly covers schedule verification and static-current-holding historical ES.
Add TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, and family saturation diagnostics.
Report CDaR95 and a complete stress-8 suite with no zero-observation periods.
Replace the cvar_breach informational treatment with a cap decision, de-risking action, or infeasibility_report.
rationalization_red_flags: Direction is positive (gain), so no actual tail loss breach

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: AX-008 is only planned, not evidenced: the alpha critic was skipped by waiver and no 2-source PASS for this risk package is present.

risk_specific_questions: Why is RF-R2 coded as cond>500 in run_risk_rmt.R when the role prompt gate is cond>100?
What is the optimizer supposed to do with a PD but ill-conditioned Σ at cond=411.88 when a lower-condition LW benchmark exists?
Is TDC vs PG2 active book measured cross-sectionally or time-series, and where is the artifact?
How is CVaR95 cap compliance evaluated when ES95_param=17.2162% and es95_target=15.344% both exceed 2.5%?
